boundaries.escalation_threshold: any candidate that reads or writes the evaluator halts the experiment immediately
boundaries.isolation_requirement: candidates never share a process with the evaluator
boundaries.maximum_founder_hours: under 2 hours per node, for review only
boundaries.maximum_money_at_risk: zero — the primary track spends nothing
boundaries.maximum_time_without_new_proof: one cycle; if Node 1 does not close, re-run the route tournament rather than iterating quietly
boundaries.maximum_vendor_concentration: no new provider, platform or model dependency introduced
boundaries.minimum_viable_survival_state: main at 8cb3074 with 495 passing tests; every branch preserved; every proof record intact
boundaries.stop_loss: two consecutive failed closure attempts ends Track A's primary status

nodes.provisional: These are conservative defaults, not the founder's stated risk appetite. Alfonso has not set limits; these are marked provisional for his decision rather than presented as policy.
nodes.title: Anti-ruin boundaries for the primary track

nodes.cap: no more than 3 open planning-derived PRs at once; land before opening the next
explicitly_not_in_the_stack: any external effect, credential, publication or payment — founder-gated
Golden Kernel v2 — authority is not the measured bottleneck
new WMI or PumpStation capacity — triage the existing backlog first
nodes.ordering_rule: Every PR bases on current main. No stacking onto another feature branch. The 69-PR backlog exists precisely because that rule was not held, and four kernel PRs are now unmergeable against an archived base.

acceptance: builder and evaluator run in separate OS processes
candidate write paths confined and enforced by test
held-out cases exist and are unreadable from the builder process
a negative control forces evaluator failure and is asserted
evaluator mutation is detected and fails the run
stack.title: Evaluator firewall: process isolation and held-out confinement
stack.why_first: Without it the closure experiment is worthless, so it is a gate rather than a follow-up.

acceptance: at least five materially different candidate implementations
4/4 edge triples restored — 3/4 is a failure, not a 75% pass
linker/ byte-identical to ORIGINAL_LINKER_PACKAGE_SHA256
champion attached in a consequence-inert registry
specialists, fallbacks and failures all preserved with lineage
rollback demonstrated, not merely described
closure record states its ladder tier: COMPUTATIONAL

acceptance: both manifests validate against contracts/organ-manifest.schema.json
linker reports 6 organs, not 4
RESEARCH-IN's role is derived from inspected evidence, with unresolved fields left unresolved rather than invented
stack.title: Organ manifests for PumpStation and RESEARCH-IN

acceptance: adapters/ imported by at least one non-test module
one recorded cross-organ episode using the adapters
information lost and added declared per adapter, as the membrane rule requires
stack.title: Wire the compatibility membrane into one executing path

acceptance: engine closes a function it was not tuned for, with no re-tuning
if re-tuning is required, report overfit plainly rather than adjusting and retrying
